body:
Rae: Quick sprint - need a micro case (<=250w), 25s clip, and a demo CTA. Can we record Thu afternoon?
Ibrahim: I can record Thu 2:30-2:50pm PT. I'll ask 3 Qs: pain, impact, one-liner.
Marta: Customer confirmed Thu. Please send Qs + a one-line release up front.
Priya: Legal: require explicit quote + logo permission. If they include numbers, get a signed approval email.
Rae: Draft Qs: 1) What problem were you solving? 2) What changed after Redwood (any metrics)? 3) One short quote for social.
Ibrahim: Uploaded prep doc + two quote variants to Drive and pinged customer for one-line approval.
SFDC-bot: Please tag incoming leads: Case: MICRO-0026 and route EU clicks to EU SDR queue.
Rae: Timeline: record Thu, edit Fri AM, legal signoff Fri afternoon, publish next Wed. All agreed?
Priya: I'll archive the approval to /marketing/legal/releases/microcase-0026.pdf once received. Please cc me.
Marta: Sounds good. I'll confirm recording attendees and drop screenshot after.
Rae: Thanks team :rocket:
